environment.isolation: hostless v2 wrapper (in place from 05:06:31Z, before the PREREG commit and every counted run): removes desktop and session variables (DISPLAY, WAYLAND_*, HYPRLAND_*, SWAYSOCK, I3SOCK, DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS, AT_SPI_BUS_ADDRESS, XAUTHORITY, XDG_SESSION_TYPE and related), points XDG_RUNTIME_DIR at a private per-invocation dir, and applies a Landlock scope that blocks connect() to abstract unix sockets bound outside the scope and signals to processes outside it. It does not use bwrap and does not mask socket directories (that was v1). No display, no D-Bus session, no AT-SPI; no GUI session started
environment.locks: shared quiet-lane lock + exclusive cargo-build lock held for every cargo invocation (no timing claims)
environment.concurrent_load: other lanes were running (loadavg about 11-20 during counted passes); recorded because R1's one FAIL is a scheduling race

commands.wrapper: hostless flock -s <locks>/quiet-lane.lock flock <locks>/cargo-build.lock env CARGO_HOME=<cargo-home> CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<cargo-targets>/<dir> TMPDIR=<lane-tmp> cargo test ...
